description: Energy Technology RD&D Budgets is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Policies and plans", published or maintained by IEA Compliance (International Energy Agency (IEA)). The database is subject to the IEA’s Terms and Conditions, available at The IEA’s Energy Technology RD&D Budgets database allows users to track trends in spending by energy technology in IEA countries back to 1974. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 5 files in Other. The portal files it under Policies and plans. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is restricted or on request according to the listing; the conditions were not read. The licence is other closed licence (terms not stated in the catalogue entry). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
